title: spherical-ramsey: which finite spherical sets are Euclidean Ramsey (Lean 4 ropes, exact certificates, probes, note and conjecture ledger)
description:
Lean 4 proofs, exact certificates and numerical probes about which finite sets of points on a sphere are Euclidean Ramsey, building on OpenAI's classification of finite Euclidean Ramsey configurations (openai/math, result 172) and its Lean proof, which is trusted. Every result carries its verification level: LEAN (checked by stock Comparator, standard axioms only), CERT (an exact symbolic identity, determinant or certificate checked by a script, plus a written argument), HAND (a written proof, reviewed by AI only) or PROBE (evidence, not proof). Five Lean ropes, standalone packages each checked by Comparator on a fresh runner: finite spherical sets with algebraic coordinates are Ramsey (prior work; a further proof); any six or fewer points on a circle are Ramsey; the radian nine-gon (nine distinct points) is Ramsey if and only if e^{i theta} is algebraic; the Ramsey property of a spherical set is Moebius invariant (Theorem C, published in mobius-ramsey); algebraic concyclic points plus at most three arbitrary points are Ramsey. The two-group theorem: a union of two Moebius images of finite algebraic subsets of the sphere S^{d-1} is Ramsey for every d >= 2 (HAND, AI-reviewed), with exact certificates on S^1 to S^5 (CERT). Exact certificates also give cyclic Ramsey sets that are not unions of two Moebius images of algebraic sets (CERT plus glue, reviewed by AI), and non-Ramsey configurations on S^2 and S^3. A note states each claim at its level, and a conjecture ledger keeps the open and refuted conjectures with replay commands.

AI disclosure. The author, Will Strinz, is the only human contributor. The proofs, the Lean, the certificates, the probes, the checks and the documentation were produced by AI agents (Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5.5, Anthropic, in Claude Code) under his direction. Every review reported here is an AI review, except the author's own read; no human expert has reviewed this work. See DISCLOSURE.md.
